title: Custom Aggregation with Aggregate
description: Learn to perform custom aggregation operations using the Aggregate operator.

data.text: The `Aggregate` method performs custom accumulation operations on a collection. It has three overloads:

data.title: Aggregate Method Signatures
Basic Aggregate

data.text: The second overload allows you to specify a seed value to start the accumulation:

data.title: Aggregate with Seed
data.content: Adding a prefix to the accumulation

data.text: The third overload allows you to specify a result selector to transform the final accumulation:

data.title: Aggregate with Result Selector
Aggregate for Sum
Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: The Aggregate operator is not supported in query syntax in C# or VB.NET.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Three overloads: basic, with seed, and with result selector
Seed value provides a starting point for accumulation
Result selector transforms the final result
data.takeaway: Continue to the next module to learn about quantifiers and element operators.
